caption: The drawing depicts a side view of a weather vane in the shape of a horse in full gallop, with all four legs extended outward from the body to indicate motion. The horse is rendered in shades of dark green and black with hints of blue, giving it a metallic appearance suggestive of oxidized copper or bronze. The mane and tail are both flowing, aligned in the direction of the horse's movement, and the horse's musculature and joints are carefully defined. The horse is mounted on a vertical rod, which is attached to a horizontal bar below; the bar serves as the base of the weather vane and is a duller, dark green color with some brownish tones at the joint where the vertical rod meets the base. The background is an off-white or beige color with slight discoloration along the edges and corners, and there is a black triangular section in the upper right corner. The composition centers the horse and the structure supporting it within the rectangular space.
title: Weather Vane
